## Summary

<!-- What changed, and why is this the smallest coherent change? -->

## Validation

<!-- List exact commands, corpora, validators, and relevant before/after data. -->

- [ ] The change has one purpose and avoids unrelated cleanup.
- [ ] New behavior has a regression test, or the reason it cannot is explained.
- [ ] SAT models, UNSAT proofs, and cores affected by this change are validated.
- [ ] Incompleteness or resource exhaustion returns `unknown`, never a guess.
- [ ] Performance claims use preregistered corpora and preserve raw results.
- [ ] User-facing behavior and capability claims are documented honestly.
- [ ] `make check` passes locally.
- [ ] `make check-msrv` and `make audit` pass locally.
